title.zh: EQ 各频段的增益/频率/Q 也能画包络了
title.en: An EQ band's gain, frequency and Q can now be drawn as envelopes

highlights.zh: 自动化补齐 insert 链：低/中/高各频段的 gainDb、hz、q 共九项都能画包络，量程与面板滑杆同源（±18 dB、20–18000 Hz、Q 0.2–12）。
highlights.en: Automation now covers the insert chain: gainDb, hz and q for each of the three EQ bands — nine fields — on the same ranges the panel's sliders use (±18 dB, 20–18000 Hz, Q 0.2–12).

highlights.zh: 曲线画在已旁通的频段上会自动打开该频段（否则听不到，会让人以为功能坏了）；调度直接写 AudioParam，不会每步重建路由。
highlights.en: A curve drawn on a bypassed band switches that band on — otherwise it would be inaudible and read as broken. The value is scheduled straight at the AudioParam, so routing is not rebuilt on every step.

title.zh: 效果机架跟着编排走：界面与协议都能改，且渲染真的带上
title.en: The effect rack follows the arrangement — editable in the UI and over the protocol, and carried into a render

highlights.zh: set_arrangement_effects 增加 rack：滤波 cutoff/Q/type、饱和 drive、合唱 mix/rate、位深，部分补丁、越界钳位。只改一个阶段不会重置其它阶段。
highlights.en: set_arrangement_effects now takes a rack: filter cutoff/Q/type, saturation drive, chorus mix/rate and bit depth — a partial patch, clamped, where naming one stage leaves the others as the genre left them.

highlights.zh: 修掉一个会静默丢设置的缺陷：界面的机架旋钮只推给引擎、没有存储，genre 变更或重载就会把它改回去。现在写入编排并与协议同一份存储。
highlights.en: One silent defect fixed: the interface's rack knobs pushed values at the engine and stored nothing, so a genre change or a reload rewrote them. They now store on the arrangement, the same place the protocol writes.

title.zh: 混响/延迟可由协议调，声像与发送也能画包络
title.en: Reverb and delay are settable over the protocol, and pan or send lanes can be drawn

highlights.zh: 新增 set_arrangement_effects：按编排覆写混响 decay/damping/preDelay 与延迟 time/feedback/damp/pingPong，部分补丁、越界钳位。总线是实时参数，改动立即生效不切断音符。
highlights.en: A new set_arrangement_effects overrides an arrangement's reverb (decay, damping, preDelay) and delay (time, feedback, damp, pingPong) — a partial patch, clamped. Both buses take live changes, so no note is cut.

highlights.zh: 自动化不再只支持音量：声像、混响/延迟发送都可画包络，各自按本参数的量程显示，轨道头可下拉切换。
highlights.en: Automation is no longer level-only: pan and both sends can be drawn as envelopes, each on its own scale, with a field selector in the track header.

title.zh: 母带可调：压缩/限幅/宽度在 Web 与 MCP 都能改，且立刻生效
title.en: Mastering is editable: compressor, limiter and width, on both Web and MCP, applied at once

highlights.zh: 新增母带设置块（母线压缩阈值/膝/比/释放/补偿、限幅器上限与释放、立体声宽度），存在工程里，Web 的音频设置面板可调，MCP 用 set_arrangement_master 读写；导出与渲染都按它母带。
highlights.en: A mastering block (bus compressor threshold/knee/ratio/release/makeup, limiter ceiling and releases, stereo width) stored on the project, editable in the Web audio settings, readable and writable over MCP with set_arrangement_master, and used by both the export and a render.

highlights.zh: 改动立刻生效：压缩器与限幅器本在建图时固定，所以面板改动会重建母带链并重接各轨（代价如实写明：正在发声的音符会被切断）。
highlights.en: A change applies at once: the compressors and limiter are fixed when a chain is built, so the panel rebuilds the master chain and re-points the tracks — with the cost stated in the UI, that a note sounding at that instant is cut.

title.zh: 编排：音量包络有了可画的车道，点/拖/方向键都能改
title.en: Arrangement: the level curve has a lane you can draw on — click, drag or nudge it

highlights.zh: 轨道头新增 ∿ 开关，打开后该轨下方出现一条曲线：按拍画点、拖动改点、方向键微调（Shift 加大步长），空车道按一下即加第一个点。
highlights.en: A ∿ toggle in the track header opens that track's curve below the lanes: click to add a point, drag to move one, arrow keys to nudge (Shift for a larger step). A press on an empty lane adds the first point.

highlights.zh: 一次手势只写一次模型：拖动期间曲线留在组件内，松手才提交整条曲线，所以一个拖动就是一个撤销步（不是每个像素一步）。
highlights.en: One gesture writes the model once: the curve stays in the component while the pointer is down and the whole curve is committed on release, so a drag is a single undo step rather than one per pixel.

title.zh: 编排：轨道音量可有连续包络，渐强渐弱不必再切分段
title.en: Arrangement: a track's level can be a continuous envelope, so a fade is not cut into pieces

highlights.zh: 按 docs/DAW_GAP_ARRANGEMENT.md §8 第 4 项做：点用拍、值用 dB，区间外保持平直（外推会越过 +6 dB 上限），两点之间直线；曲线在编译期展开成每步增益，活引擎与离线渲染共用一份。
highlights.en: Built as docs/DAW_GAP_ARRANGEMENT.md §8's fourth item: points in beats, values in dB, flat outside the points (extrapolating would pass the +6 dB ceiling) and straight between them; the compile expands it to a per-step gain shared by the live engine and the offline renderer.

highlights.zh: 顺带修一处真 bug：活引擎把推子钳在 1.0，而编译一直能写到 2.0（+6 dB）、离线混音也认，同一工程在房间里比在文件里更轻。
highlights.en: A real bug went with it: the live engine clamped the fader at 1.0 while the compile has always been able to write 2.0 (+6 dB) and the offline mixer honoured it, so a project was quieter in the room than in the file.

title.zh: 手机片段：拒绝播放的原因被丢掉了，状态行说不清是哪一种
title.en: Phone clips: the refusal reason was discarded, so the line could not say which failure it was

highlights.zh: 播放器本来算出了原因（浏览器拒绝、还是这段片段取不到），外壳却把参数丢掉，所以只说「无法播放」。现在原因随状态行一起给出。
highlights.en: The player already worked out the reason — the browser refused, or the clip would not load — and the shell dropped the argument, so the line could only say that it failed. The reason now travels with it.

highlights.zh: 状态行的优先级抽成纯函数并加了判据：拒绝播放会让 isPlaying 变 false，写成 isPlaying ? 播放中 : 空闲 就会把「被拒」显示成「没点过」。
highlights.en: The status precedence became a pure function with a criterion: a refusal makes isPlaying false, so a naive `isPlaying ? playing : idle` reports "never started" for exactly the case the user needs to know about.

title.zh: 手机唱片：进度条走到底就不动了，切歌还会黑一下
title.en: Phone record: the bar stopped at the end, and a track change flashed empty

highlights.zh: 进度条读的是「从片段开始算了多少步」，却在第一步循环之后就被钳在 100%：chicago-house 16.6 秒、124 BPM，条在 1.94 秒就满了。现在按循环取余，它会一直转。
highlights.en: The bar read the step count since the clip began, then clamped at 100 % after the first loop: chicago-house is 16.6 s at 124 BPM, and the bar filled at 1.94 s. It is reduced modulo the loop now, so it keeps cycling.

highlights.zh: 切歌时封面会先清空再加载，唱片中间的图因此空白一段时间，看起来就是黑一下。现在旧封面留到新封面解码完成；解码过的封面按 URL 缓存。
highlights.en: Changing records cleared the cover before loading the next, so the artwork in the middle of the disc was blank for a moment — the flash. The previous cover now stays until the new one has decoded, and decoded covers are cached by URL.

title.zh: 手机片段：音频主机写错，159 条全指向解析不了的域名
title.en: Phone clips: all 159 audio addresses named a host that does not resolve

highlights.zh: 自 v2.37.6 起片段清单的主机写成 r2mirror.wangda.today（DNS 解析不了），正确是 r2mirror.groove.wangda.today，所以手机壳一首也放不出，只是安静。159 条已重指。
highlights.en: Since v2.37.6 the clip manifest named r2mirror.wangda.today, which does not resolve; the mirror is r2mirror.groove.wangda.today, so the phone shell could not play a single clip — the only symptom was silence. All 159 are re-pointed.

highlights.zh: 发版门禁新增片段清单检查：上传前比对每条片段的主机与所配置镜像，不一致就拒绝发布。
highlights.en: The deploy gate now checks the clip manifest too: before anything is uploaded, every clip's host is compared against the configured mirror and a mismatch refuses the release.

title.zh: 手机片段：拒绝播放要说出来，下一首先取好
title.en: Phone clips: a refusal is said out loud, and the next record is fetched early

highlights.zh: 浏览器拒绝 play() 或片段取不到时，界面原本一直显示「播放中」且无提示；现在状态行报「无法播放 —— 点播放重试」。
highlights.en: When the browser refused play() or the clip would not load, the shell kept showing "playing" with nothing on screen to say otherwise; the status line now reads "Could not play — tap play to retry".

highlights.zh: 切歌不再现拉：当前这首播放时预取队列的下一首，切歌成为缓存命中（repeat-one 不预取）。
highlights.en: Switching records no longer waits on the network: the queue's next clip is warmed while the current one plays, so an advance is a cache hit (repeat-one warms nothing).
